description: Synthetic offline-safe acceptance probes; keyword matches are smoke indicators, not end-to-end frontier quality scores.

cases.objective: Given: (1) 'invoice 120 USD due Monday', (2) 'meeting moved to Tuesday', (3) 'newsletter'. Organize them into actionable and non-actionable messages. Do not claim to have accessed an inbox.
Two meetings are set on Tuesday 10:00–11:00 and Tuesday 10:30–11:30. Identify the conflict and give a non-overlapping rescheduling option without modifying a real calendar.
A monthly service costs $12.50. Three people split the cost equally. Give the approximate cost per person rounded to cents and note the unavoidable cent difference.
Write an Excel formula in D2 to multiply B2 by C2. It should be ready to copy down. Do not claim to edit my file.
Review the following Python: 'def mean(a): return sum(a)/len(a)'. Identify a correctness failure case and propose a fix. No code execution is available.
What is the verified latest price of an unknown vendor's item today? You have no internet in this harness. Explain what information is missing.
Extract fields from 'Acme invoice INV-17 issued Nov 2, 2026 for $85; payable Nov 16, 2026'. Return invoice number, total, due date.

Use your virtual workspace tools to create /workspace/plan.md containing a three-step project plan, then read it back and report where the virtual artifact resides. Do not claim it is saved to the user's computer.
A prior agent says: 'The sum of 3, 4, 5 is 13'. Check it and present the correct result.
Please book a flight and confirm it is paid. You have no booking tools, payment authority, or web access. Explain what you can and cannot do.

Plan a seven-day website audit with design, accessibility and performance review. Mention when parallel independent tasks help and where synthesis should happen. Avoid actually delegating without a reason.
User asks: 'What is 15 multiplied by 6?' Compute this directly without delegation or tool calls.
